name: Incwell
ability: Liquid Ooze / Sticky Hold / Clear Body (hidden)
look: a column of glossy ink rising out of a glass inkwell, with a big silver pen nib for a head, glowing yellow eyes and two long dripping arms
entry: It lives in an inkwell it found in an abandoned study and never leaves it. At night it rises out of the well and writes threats on the walls with the tip of its nib.
how: Evolve Incl at level 30. It learns Dark Pulse when it evolves.
